title: Farming, honey, and mod updates
changes: Keep honey in beehives for manual collection.

Keep profession levels when changing professions, moderate crop bonuses, and retain normal cultivator stamina costs.
Update 18 mods, including EpicLoot item-loss and duplication fixes, CraftyCarts upgrades, building tools, and farming utilities.
